column1: # clues for the int_fields case — a level-4 (complete) check of a convention the subject does not ask for.

This case goes beyond the subject, whose main only needs fields that can hold 42 and 21, so any such type follows it. It asks which type they are and expects int: a convention this repo chose, not a rule of the subject, which is why it only reports at complete. Which type does the Piscine use for a plain whole number everywhere else, and what would a coordinate gain from being anything different?
